claim_order_rule: ascending membership_hash; representative = alphabetically first name
split_rule: within each T5 date, rank(anchor value, method='first') after sorting by (value, ticker); LOW = rank <= n/2. Ties resolve by ticker alphabetically so parquet row order can never be a hidden input.
estimand: theta_s = sum_b w_sb * [median(Y|S=1,b) - median(Y|S=0,b)], treated-episode weights
null: Y permutation within registered blocks; ONE permutation map across all claims
promotion: observed theta > p95 of max-null across all k claims
exchangeability_assumption: Under the null, outcomes are exchangeable with respect to sequence membership within the registered date x pre-liquidity x pre-volatility blocks. Ticker-specific heterogeneity is NOT fully controlled by this design.
